objective: Make Stream sexual-harassment-only results publishable while preserving the provider label for moderator review.
userOutcome: Consensual explicit queer content is not blocked solely because Stream applies SEXUAL_HARASSMENT, including Feed posts and profile bios.
audience: Adult cruush members and cruush moderators.
successCriteria: A harassment-only Stream result maps to allow even when Stream recommends Flag.
Allowed harassment-only results retain normalized labels, policy evidence, and flagged moderator-review status.
Feed posts, messages, profiles, and other text surfaces can publish harassment-only results.
Threat, hate-speech, scam, mixed unsafe-label, provider-outage, and all image behavior remains unchanged.
Focused regression tests, server build, copy checks, and scope checks pass.
The verified commit reaches origin/main and production reports the same build SHA.
The allowed sample persists after reload on live Feed and Bio, then the test post is deleted and the original Bio is restored.
mustPreserve: Preserve every non-harassment moderation decision, trust penalty, account restriction, provider fallback, image rule, environment variable, UI surface, and unrelated user work.
Keep Stream's configured SEXUAL_HARASSMENT label available to moderators as review evidence.
nonGoals: Do not change the Stream dashboard policy, add UI, change database schema, add migrations, or tune any non-harassment label.
Do not send external messages or alter unrelated application behavior.

assumptions.impact: The review-only exception matches only the intended Stream label.

assumptions.statement: Threats and hate speech continue arriving as their existing separate normalized labels.
assumptions.impact: Threat and hate enforcement remains outside the harassment-only exception.

nextVisibleMilestone: Production Feed and Bio accept the allowed sample after the deployed build SHA matches origin/main.
stopConditions: Stop only for a password form, user browser takeover, non-fast-forward main, failed safety check, or production build mismatch.

externalEffectDecisions.push: authorized to origin/main by Julien's current instruction
externalEffectDecisions.deploy: authorized to production by Julien's current instruction

job: Implement, verify, push, deploy, and live-test harassment-only review behavior.
proofTarget: Focused mapper and service assertions, scoped diff, server build, origin/main SHA, production /api/build SHA, and restored live Feed/Bio smoke actions.
publicationTarget: origin/main and cruush production through Coolify.
requiredEvidence: Focused test proves harassment-only Flag allows and remains flagged for review.
Focused test proves a mixed harassment plus threat result still rejects.
Server build and cruush casing/copy checks pass.
Clean scoped commit and matching origin/main SHA.
Live Feed and Bio accept the allowed sample after reload; temporary content is removed and the original Bio restored.
